svg.title: AkashaLens
svg.desc: AkashaLens: cloud removal for Sentinel-2 satellite imagery. A tile grid where clouds drift over a block of tiles and a sweep reveals a reconstruction drawn with cobalt hatching and a dashed outline, with coral tiles marking low-confidence regions. Beside it the pipeline: Sentinel-2 imagery, a rule-based cloud mask, a U-Net, and a reconstruction with a confidence heatmap. A prototype for ISRO Hackathon 2026, trained on a tiny sample set.
svg.text: CLOUD REMOVAL FOR SENTINEL-2 IMAGERY · A U-NET RECONSTRUCTION PROTOTYPE
Conceptual scene. Prototype: 3 sample pairs, no trained weights shipped, no accuracy claims.
